reviews.title: waste of time - they deleted my old logged images from just a few months back
reviews.text: I paid $35 for a year of this to track my weight loss progress. i took a bunch of photos a few months back and uploaded them here & today went to look at them to compare myself now to then & it says “no previous uploads / logs”. i know for a fact that i correctly uploaded them, because there was a few weeks in a row i was taking and uploading the images so they were showing. i did not get a new phone or clear my data. so i wasted $35 for nothing.
reviews.author: charlottesdarkweb

reviews.title: Simple and To The Point
reviews.text: Exactly what I need for objective progress tracking. I paid up front to support the devs, avoid ads, and have a committed tool for the year. The ability to track body photos and face photos in separate journeys is really powerful when implementing lifestyle changes. Thank you for this app that delivers an easy experience that meets what it offers!! That's rare these days.
reviews.author: bree1024

reviews.title: App DELETED all my PHOTOS & JOURNEYS
reviews.text: I still have a 1-year active subscription that doesn’t expire until November 2025. I had 5 Journeys I had created. One day I open the app & ALL my photos had been deleted, which also meant all my 5 Journeys had been deleted. There was literally nothing left. Even worse, my absolute mistake in hindsight, the app gives you the option to save the photos you take in your camera roll on the phone or only in the app on your journeys—idiot me chose “save in app only”. I had daily things I tracked for months. Oh & btw, this is the second review I’m leaving bc when this occurred a few months back, nothing was done about this. I’m still paying for months that I don’t have access to & journeys I have to start all over, which really blows to lose all that progress tracking, gone. Would give negative stars if I could. DO NOT USE THIS APP.

reviews.author: Onehitkilloneesan

reviews.title: Great app, terrible cost
reviews.text:
The app is really well made and helpful, but once you are committed and you hit the limits on the free version, you are asked to pay $8/week or $35/year before being able to take more pictures, despite the fact that I think it runs entirely on your phone (no backend costs).

Those prices are way too much. Which is a shame, because like I said, it's a well-made app. I would have definitely paid for the Pro version if the cost was more reasonable, but instead I will have to abandon it for now. If the price is lowered in the future I would love to come back to it.

reviews.author: sonfloower

reviews.title: Best app after trying everything out there!
reviews.text: I am tracking my fitness journey and needed an app to photo-track body composition changes. I tried so many apps. There were no other apps that were this clean and simple to use and did exactly what I was looking for (take daily photos and be able to easily stitch it together in a photo lapse). When I originally downloaded the app, the controls were not working correctly. I reached out to the app designers and they were unbelievably helpful. They released an update literally as a result of my request and fixed the controls. I love this app and the team behind it. Thank you so much!
